title: Derivatives and areas, checked numerically
instructions:
## Differentiate, integrate, verify

The checker compares your expression with the correct one at many points, so any equivalent form is accepted: `x*cos(x) + sin(x)` and `sin(x) + x cos(x)` are both fine.

## Do this

1. Differentiate f(x) = x·sin(x) (product rule).
2. Differentiate g(x) = e^(2x) + ln(x).
3. Compute the definite integral of 2x from 0 to 3. Plot `2x` and read the area under it as a triangle to confirm.
4. Find the slope of y = x³ at x = 2.
hints: d/dx e^(kx) = k e^(kx); d/dx ln(x) = 1/x.
The integral of 2x is x²; evaluate between the limits.
